item.title: About
item.author: gizemsoylu.tr@gmail.com (Gizem Nur Soylu)
item.description:
Hey — I’m Gi.

I design intelligent enterprise systems on SAP BTP, where cloud-native architecture meets Generative AI and agentic automation.

At NTT DATA Business Solutions Denmark, I design CAP and RAP-based solutions enhanced with SAP AI Core, SAP Joule, and SAP Build Agents — enabling AI-driven decision support, intelligent document processing, and autonomous workflow execution. My work focuses on transforming traditional enterprise applications into adaptive, AI-augmented systems.

Beyond project work, I share practical tutorials on my YouTube channel BTP Stack. Code-first content that reflects how SAP BTP is actually used in production.

item.title: Connecting a Local SAP CAP Application to SAP BTP PostgreSQL in Hybrid Profile
item.author: gizemsoylu.tr@gmail.com (Gizem Nur Soylu)
item.description:
Introduction

This document explains how to connect a local SAP CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) application to a PostgreSQL database running on SAP BTP (PostgreSQL – Hyperscaler Option).

Before proceeding, the following prerequisites are assumed to be fulfilled:

  • A PostgreSQL (Hyperscaler Option) service instance has already been created on SAP BTP.
  • A Service Instance Key has been generated for this PostgreSQL instance.
  • The developer has access to the instance key credentials in JSON format (including database name, host, port, user, password, and SSL certificate).
